claim: Original retail Unity 5.6.5p3 extensionless globalgamemanagers contains a 562-byte ClassID30 GraphicsSettings object PathID7 SHA256 6edfe78d3eeabc9e45d18cb65c55b7499fc4301e8716c160cdd129ba53f1502d. Complete structured byte parse identifies eight built-in shader settings with numeric external file and path references, exactly 28 always-included shader pointers, zero preloaded shader-variant collections, a sprite-default material reference, a null custom-render-pipeline reference, transparency sort mode0 and axis (0,0,1), three graphics tier records and two final lighting flags. Tier1 and Tier2 have original realtimeGICPUUsage=25 and Tier3 has 50, while all three hdrMode values are 1. These are precise build-source settings and references, not direct evidence of assets at the pointer destinations or which shader executed in a match.
